entry: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.
name: Gabite

entry: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.
name: Garchomp

entry: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.
name: Garchomp-Mega

entry: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.
name: Munchlax

entry: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.
name: Riolu

entry: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.
name: Lucario

name: Lucario-Mega

entry: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.
name: Hippowdon

entry: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.
name: Skorupi

entry: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.
name: Drapion

entry: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.
name: Croagunk

entry: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.
name: Toxicroak

entry: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.
name: Carnivine

entry: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

entry: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.
name: Lumineon

entry: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.
name: Mantyke

entry: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.
name: Snover

entry: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

name: Abomasnow-Mega

name: Magnezone

entry: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

entry: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

entry: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.
name: Tangrowth

entry: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

entry: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.
name: Magmortar

entry: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

entry: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

entry: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

name: Victini

name: Snivy

name: Servine

name: Tepig

name: Pignite

entry: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
name: Emboar

entry: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

entry: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
name: Watchog

entry: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

entry: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.
name: Herdier

entry: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.
name: Stoutland

entry: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.
name: Purrloin

entry: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.
name: Liepard

entry: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.
name: Pansage

entry: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
name: Simisage

entry: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Pansear

entry: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
name: Simisear

entry: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
name: Panpour

entry: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
name: Simipour

entry: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.
name: Munna

entry: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.
name: Musharna

entry: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.
name: Pidove

entry: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.
name: Tranquill

entry: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.
name: Unfezant

entry: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

entry: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

entry: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

entry: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

entry: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.
name: Gigalith

entry: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

entry: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

entry: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

entry: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

entry: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

entry: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

entry: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

entry: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.
name: Gurdurr

entry: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.
name: Conkeldurr

entry: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.
name: Tympole

entry: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

entry: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

entry: They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.

entry: The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.

entry: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

entry: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

entry: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

entry: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.

entry: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.

entry: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

entry: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.

entry: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

entry: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

entry: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

entry: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

entry: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.
